title: macrolenes alstonii
intro: Macrolenes alstonii, commonly known as Alstonia, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Macrolenes alstonii include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
